name: curl_modify_url
title: Modify an existing URL or build one from parts with libcurl.

origin.description: Modify an existing URL or build one from parts with libcurl. Arguments are URL-encoded unless wrapped in I(). A named params vector overrides query.
origin.details: Modify an existing URL or build one from parts with libcurl. Arguments are URL-encoded unless wrapped in I(). A named params vector overrides query.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.

translation.description: Modify an existing URL or build one from parts with libcurl. Arguments are URL-encoded unless wrapped in AsIs. A params dict overrides query.
translation.details: Modify an existing URL or build one from parts with libcurl. Arguments are URL-encoded unless wrapped in AsIs. A params dict overrides query.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
from curl import curl_modify_url, curl_parse_url
url = "https://jerry:secret@google.com:888/foo/bar?test=123#bla"
print(curl_modify_url(curl_parse_url(url)), end="")
